items.reason: A fragrance-free, active-free cleanser that keeps oily skin feeling clean without stripping it.
A gentle leave-on cream that helps skin look clearer and more even-toned, and it suits pregnancy-conscious routines.
A light mattifying moisturizer that adds comfort to low-moisture skin while keeping shine in check.
A mineral SPF 50 for daily protection that is gentle on skin that looks red and reactive.

response.routine_note: Use the cleanser, moisturizer and SPF in the morning, and the cleanser, azelaic cream and moisturizer at night. I left out the strongest benzoyl peroxide wash, retinoids and strong peels, so please ask your prenatal provider or a dermatologist about severe breakouts and which stronger options suit pregnancy.
